Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani visited the Mahudi Jain Temple in Gandhinagar on Wednesday. He was accompanied by his wife, Dr Priti Adani, their elder son, Karan Adani, and daughter-in-law, Paridhi. The family offered prayers and sought blessings as the Jain community prepares for 'Paryushan Mahaparva', which begins on September 8.

comment: Such visits also highlight how business leadership often carries cultural responsibilities beyond operations, shaping community connections and values that influence stakeholder trust over generations.
